feedback: The application dashboard takes more than 15 seconds to load our weekly reports.
Dashboard loading speed is terribly slow, sometimes taking 20 seconds.
Loading the main dashboard is extremely sluggish. We need this to be fast.
The dashboard takes way too long to load every morning.
Exporting customer data to CSV randomly fails with a 500 server error.
CSV export button throws an error half the time we try to run monthly exports.
Data export to CSV is completely broken on large datasets.
The pricing structure is very confusing. We got surprised by overage charges on our invoice.
Unexpected overage charges on our monthly bill. Pricing tiers are not transparent at all.
Too expensive for small teams. The jump from Starter ($29) to Pro ($199) is way too steep.
Pricing is prohibitive for early stage startups. Please consider a team tier between basic and pro.
Cannot find the team member invite button in the new settings redesign.
The settings menu is completely cluttered. It took me 10 minutes to locate user permissions.
Navigation in the new update is very confusing. Where did the project switcher go?
The user interface is confusing after the last update. Too many clicks to accomplish basic tasks.
The mobile version of the analytics tab is completely broken on iPhone 15.
Mobile view is basically unusable. Charts overflow outside the screen viewport.
Can we please get a native mobile app or at least responsive web layouts on iPad?
Getting started was painful. The onboarding tour broke on step 3 and locked the screen.
Onboarding documentation is severely outdated. The screenshots show a previous version.
Support team took 4 days to reply to our urgent blocker ticket.
Support response time has degraded significantly over the past two months.
The recent AI summarizer feature is fantastic! Saved our team hours of manual categorization.
Really love the clean dark mode and keyboard shortcuts.
We need SAML / SSO integration before our infosec team can approve company-wide rollout.
Are there any plans for SOC2 compliance or Okta SSO? We cannot upgrade without SSO.
Two-factor authentication via authenticator app should be mandatory for admin roles.
Would love a direct webhook or Zapier integration to send alerts to our Slack channels.
Slack notification integration is desperately needed for our triage workflow.
Integration with Jira or Linear would make this tool 10x more useful for PMs.
Filtering by date range resets every time I switch views. Very annoying bug.
Date filter keeps resetting when navigating between dashboard tabs.
Search indexing seems broken. Searching for exact customer names yields zero results.
Search is unresponsive or returns blank results when searching for alphanumeric IDs.
The CSV export format changed without notice and broke our downstream data pipelines.
Please add dark mode support to the mobile view.
Role-based access control is too coarse. We need read-only access for guest stakeholders.
Our contractors only need read-only access to specific dashboards, not full project admin rights.
The billing portal rejected our European VAT ID and charged tax incorrectly.
Cannot update billing contact email address without contacting support.
The app frequently freezes when opening a board with more than 500 items.
Freezes and browser tab crashes whenever a large dataset is rendered.
Great progress on recent releases! The performance on small projects is buttery smooth.
Automated email notifications cannot be customized. They look like spam to our clients.
Email digest formatting looks broken in Microsoft Outlook desktop client.
Would be great to export dashboards directly to PDF for executive presentations.
No way to download slide-ready executive reports. We have to screenshot every widget.
Notification badges do not clear even after reading all unread messages.
Unread notification counter badge is persistently stuck at 3.
API rate limits are too restrictive (60 req/min). We hit 429 errors during sync runs.
Need higher rate limits on the REST API for scheduled data warehouse synchronization.
